app.title: Sanitation and waste planner
app.tag: From an SFD and a WFD to what to build
app.failed: The page could not load its data files. Reload to try again.
land.h1: Drop the SFD report, the WFD report, or both.
land.lede: The reports show where a town's excreta and waste end up. This reads them together and works out what to build, how big, and what it stops.
land.drop_sub: or choose files: an SFD or SFD Lite report, a WFD portal page saved as PDF, or one of each
land.private: Files are read inside this browser. Nothing is sent anywhere.
land.sample_pick: One of 50 Bangladeshi municipalities with both reports
read.sfd: Sanitation report for {town}: {n} systems found, covering {sum} of people
read.wfd: Waste report for {town}: {tonnes} tonnes of plastic escape a year
read.not_listed: Not on SuSanA's SFD portal list
read.not_checked: SuSanA listing not checked: our copy of the list does not cover this name
read.unknown: {name} is not an SFD report or a WFD portal page this tool can read. Use "Type the figures" instead.
read.failed: {name} could not be opened as a PDF.
read.scanned: {name} has no readable text. It may be a scan.
check.lede: Nothing is filled in for you. Where a report leaves a gap, it is asked here.
check.name: Town
check.sfd_none: No sanitation report loaded. The analysis will cover solid waste only.
check.wfd_none: No waste report loaded. The analysis will cover sanitation only.
check.sum_bad: The shares add up to {sum}%. {gap}% of people are not accounted for.
check.ask_gap: The report's text leaves some people out: its matrix is a picture this tool cannot read. Enter the missing shares from the report's SFD matrix, as % of people.
check.ask_manual: Enter the share of people on each kind of system, from the SFD matrix, as %.
check.ask_emptied: The report does not say how many of these are emptied. Enter % emptied, or leave blank for none.
check.ask_sludge: The report does not give the share of a septic tank's contents that is sludge. Leave blank to count it all as sludge.
check.sludge: Sludge share of septic tank contents (%)
check.ask_wfd: The page did not give these. Enter them from the WFD if you have them.
check.ask_wfd_manual: Enter the WFD results. Tonnes are per year unless stated.
err.name: Enter the town's name.
err.share_sum: The sanitation shares add up to {sum}%, not 100%. Add the missing systems or correct a figure.
err.wfd_missing: The waste figures need at least: waste generated, share collected, plastic generated and plastic escaped.
err.stage_sum: The WFD stages add up to {sum} tonnes, but escaped plastic is {total} tonnes.
err.nothing: There is nothing to analyse yet. Add a report or type the figures.

basis.uploaded_both: Based on the uploaded SFD and WFD reports.
basis.b.edited: as per uploaded PDF, then edited

fail.waste_sub: {unmanaged} tonnes of plastic escape a year ({share} of plastic waste): {water} tonnes into water, {drain} into drains.
verdict.flags: Check before you rely on this
flag.none: No contradiction found in the figures.
flag.compound: Excreta and plastic meet in the same drains and water: the excreta of {persons} people and {tonnes} tonnes of plastic a year. Both loads are above the middle of the {n} paired towns ({both} towns are). Plastic blocks drains, and a blocked drain holds sewage in the street. Neither report shows this alone.
flag.safe_mismatch: The report states {stated} safely managed, but its own shares rebuild to {rebuilt}. Check the matrix against the text.
flag.shares_filled: The report's text accounted for {sum} of people. The rest was entered by hand.
flag.shares_edited: Sanitation figures were changed by hand after upload.
flag.gw_dependence: {share} of the town counts as safe only because groundwater is assumed low. If it is high, the excreta of {persons} more people is not contained. Test it in the sandbox.
flag.household_size: {pph} people per household is unusual. Check the household count.
flag.sfd_old: The SFD dates from {date}, {years} years ago.
flag.wfd_balance: The WFD stages add up to {sum} of the escaped plastic, not 100%.
flag.population_gap: The two reports use different populations: {sfd} and {wfd}.
flag.generation_low: {kg} kg of waste per person per day is among the lowest of the {n} towns (middle: {median}). Check the weighing.
flag.generation_high: {kg} kg of waste per person per day is among the highest of the {n} towns (middle: {median}). Check the weighing.
flag.portal_differs: This dataset gives {ours} tonnes of escaped plastic a year; the GIZ portal page for the town gives {portal}. The likely cause is the WFD model version. Not confirmed.
flag.dumpsite_low: The disposal site shows as only {share} of escaped plastic. This WFD does not count plastic burnt at the site.
act.unsized: Not sized here: it needs a site design.

act.shared: Shared treatment where soak pits fail
act.shared_why: With high groundwater, no household fix contains the excreta of {persons} people.
act.shared_takes: Takes about {flow} m³ a day of shared treatment.

act.collect_why: {share} of waste is never collected: {tonnes} tonnes a day.
act.collect_takes: Takes about {vans} collection vans to reach {to}.
act.dumpsite_why: {tonnes} tonnes a year go to an uncontrolled site.
act.organics_why: {share} of the waste is organic: {tonnes} tonnes a day.

box.h: Where it goes now, and what your choices stop
box.lede: Open drains, water and open ground receive both loads. Move the controls to see each one fall.
box.no_sfd: No SFD loaded: the picture shows plastic only.
box.no_wfd: No WFD loaded: the picture shows excreta only.
box.fine: Excreta follows the SFD's own rules for each system. A full fix assumes every household has the space for it and that groundwater is low. Plastic is scaled from the WFD result in proportion to the change; the WFD tool is not re-run, so the split between drains, water and land stays as today.
scene.aria: Schematic of a town: houses, an open drain, a water body and open ground, with marks for excreta and plastic
scene.schematic: A schematic, not a map. Faint marks show what your choices removed.
rcv.u_burnt: tonnes of plastic burnt in the open a year
rcv.drain_note: Toilets and tank overflows that discharge to drains; plastic that washes or is thrown in.
rcv.water_note: Direct discharge to water, and plastic that reaches it.
rcv.ground_note: Excreta discharged or leaking to ground; plastic left on land.
rcv.unseen_note: The SFD does not record where emptied sludge is tipped.

lv.uptake_none: No household fix is listed for this town's systems at this groundwater setting.

lv.gw: Test: groundwater is high (the SFD assumes low)

size.for_plan: Sized for the choices you made above.
size.none: Nothing to size at these settings.

line.compost_def: {n} tonnes of organic waste collected a day ({share} of waste).

line.unsized: Not sized: needs a site design

per.m3_day: per m³ a day of capacity
per.t_day_capacity: per tonne a day of capacity
tot.none: Enter unit rates to see the investment. The tool's own cost list is a draft, so it is shown only as a hint in each box and never added up.
tot.partial: {priced} of {total} lines priced. The rest have no rate and are left out.
rules.h: The sizing rules, their sources, and your own figures
rules.lede: Change any figure to match the town. "Cited" figures come from the named source; "assumption" figures have no source behind them and should be replaced.
run.bad: That file is not a run saved by this tool.
ev.sfd_built: SFD Lite report dated {date}, prepared by {by}.
ev.listing_listed: SuSanA's SFD portal lists "{name}" ({year}). This is a name match against our copy of the list of {date}; it does not prove a file is the published one.
ev.listing_not_listed: SuSanA's SFD portal did not list this town in our copy of its list of {date}. A report published since then would not show.
ev.listing_not_checked: Listing not checked: our copy of SuSanA's list ({date}) is partial and does not cover this name.
ev.file: The file name matches a SuSanA library download (entry {id}, {date}).
ev.wfd_dataset: Waste Flow Diagram results from the project's 50-municipality dataset (master v1.0). They are not taken from the GIZ WFD portal.
ev.wfd_portal: As per uploaded PDF: a GIZ WFD portal page, model version {v}, {model} model.
ev.wfd_typed: Figures typed in or edited by the user.
ev.wfd_portal_fig: Escaped plastic: {ours} tonnes a year here; {portal} on the GIZ portal page read on {date}.
ev.jmp_line: {town}'s SFD gives {safe} safely managed. {country}'s national figure is {nat} ({year}).
ev.jmp_none: No national figure is bundled for {country}.
ev.jmp_def: The two are not the same measure: JMP counts households using a toilet they do not share, whose excreta is safely dealt with; an SFD counts all excreta in the town. A gap between them is not an error.
ev.jmp_urban: Worldwide, {v} of urban people had safely managed sanitation in {year}.
ev.glaas_line: No GLAAS figure is used yet: none could be retrieved. GLAAS is country-level, so it will inform who pays, not the town's flags.
ev.flags_note: A note says "check this". It does not say the report is wrong.
ev.peers_h: Among 50 Bangladeshi municipalities with both reports
ev.peers_note: Each dot is one municipality; the line is this town.
ev.no_peers: The comparison set is Bangladeshi. It is not shown for towns elsewhere, and no other set is bundled.
ev.s_plastic: Plastic into drains and water, per person a year
ev.limits_h: What this tool cannot tell you
ev.limit_1: It does not estimate deaths, illness or flood damage for a town. No town-level model supports that.
ev.limit_2: It reads text. Scanned reports and the SFD matrix, which is an image, cannot be read; the tool asks instead.
ev.limit_3: The report reader has been tested on one SFD Lite report and one WFD portal page. Other layouts may fall back to typing.
ev.limit_4: The household fixes assume space on the plot and low groundwater. Neither is checked.
ev.limit_5: Sizing gives pre-feasibility numbers: enough to scope a proposal, not to design a plant.
ev.limit_6: The plastic figures after a change are scaled, not modelled. Re-run the WFD tool before quoting them.
